caption: The drawing depicts a section of a room with a fireplace, a built-in cabinet, and decorative wallpaper. The fireplace sits centrally at the bottom of the image, with a gray mantel and surround, and a hearth composed of reddish-brown bricks. Two gold fireplace andirons are visible inside the firebox, holding a single log. Above the mantel, two green vases hold stylized floral arrangements with green leaves and red-pink blossoms. The wallpaper is white with a repeating pattern of green and red-pink floral motifs. At the upper part of the wall, a wide decorative frieze runs horizontally, featuring a combination of green and red garlands, urn motifs, and stylized leaves. Green leaf-patterned borders frame parts of the wall and edge the cabinet and fireplace. The cabinet, built into the wall to the right of the fireplace, is painted gray and consists of two stacked doors, each fitted with black hinges and handles. The overall color palette includes gray, white, red-pink, green, and gold.
title: Stencilled Wall
